title: Boot a Virtual iPhone via Apple's Virtualization.framework
summary: A command-line tool that leverages Apple's official Virtualization.framework to boot and run a virtual iPhone environment directly on macOS, enabling developers and researchers to experiment with iOS virtualization without dedicated hardware.
problem_solved: Enables running virtual iOS devices on Apple Silicon Macs for development, testing, and research purposes without physical iPhone hardware.
why_valuable: Provides open-source access to Apple's native virtualization capabilities, democratizing iOS development and security research by removing the dependency on physical iOS devices.
